messages:
leigh: FYI ran the nightly linkscan and found a couple small issues in the handbook and runtime examples. dropping summary here.

nora: thanks! can you paste the exact hits? easier to triage.

leigh: two hits: `handbook/ops/oncall.md#escalation` -> 404 (looks like the anchor was renamed) and `runtime/examples/generate.md` references `examples/sample_input.json` which is missing in the repo. linkscan output attached.

pat: i can take the oncall anchor. that's in handbook, i updated frontmatter last month. will search the commit that changed anchors.

leigh: great. for the missing sample json, @nora any objections to inlining a minimal sample in the example? keeps the doc runnable without needing a separate file.

nora: fine by me. just keep it minimal. also can we add a tiny note that some examples moved into `runtime/examples/snippets/` last quarter so future checks know where to look.

ci-bot: CI: docs lint passed. small PR queued.

pat: grabbed the anchor change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook/pull/833. sedpped the anchor to `escalation-flow`. pinging reviewers.

leigh: thanks. I've started a quick PR for the runtime example to inline JSON and add a note about snippet relocation. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822

devex-bot: link-checker: staging scan found 0 new broken links in the runtime path but 1 outstanding in handbook/ops. tagging @pat.

nora: will review both PRs today. if approved, let's merge and re-run the scan.

pat: merged handbook PR. marking as owner for that page in frontmatter too.

leigh: merged docs PR 9(now staging scan passes locally). thanks all for quick turnaround!

nora: awesome, team. reminder for docs-owners: if you rename anchors please add a short redirect note in frontmatter next time. helps link-checker heuristics.

leigh: noted. will follow up with a short CONTRIBUTING note for anchors.
